query:
SELECT o.path
            FROM buildsteps s
            JOIN buildstepoutputs o
                ON s.drvPath = o.drvPath AND s.attempt = o.attempt
            WHERE s.drvPath = $1
              AND o.name = $2
              AND o.path IS NOT NULL
              AND s.status = 0
            ORDER BY s.attempt DESC
            LIMIT 1
